messages:
Alex: quick idea 1: can we add an "auto-apply snapshot" for console analytics? i.e. save a view (route+model+filters) and have the console automatically load it when someone opens that route. reduces clicks for oncall and SRE flows. tagging @Maria @Sam.
Maria: useful. couple questions: 1) should this be purely UI (client-side preference) or backed by the views API so team-shared views can auto-apply? 2) if a view carries runtime hints (sample_rate, cost_preview) do we send those to the router? that could affect telemetry.
Sam: prefer conservative defaults. UI-only and preview-only behavior initially. backend-affecting hints must be opt-in and gated with audit logs + ops approval. otherwise we risk accidental telemetry spikes and billing surprises.
Ryan: backend perspective: our saved_views table is pretty minimal. to support scope + runtime hints we need new fields: scope (user|team|org), model_id (optional), hints blob (sample_rate, quota_bucket, cost_preview), and rollout_state. API change example: POST /api/views -> {route_id, scope, model_id?, filters, hints?}. sample payload: 
```
POST /api/views
{
  "route_id": "route-77",
  "scope": "team",
  "model_id": "redwood/gpt-13b-quant",
  "filters": [{"field":"status","op":"=","value":"500"}],
  "hints": {"sample_rate":"0.02","cost_preview":true}
}
```
Maria: precedence rules needed. my suggested order: pinned user view > user recent > team-shared > org default. UI should show an explicit badge indicating active view and a small dropdown to switch. also a small warning when a view contains runtime hints.
Sam: rollout must be controlled. if a view's hints change sample rate or quota we should require a rollout_config: start_pct, ramp_steps, guard_conditions (max error delta). ops checklist: create rollout entry, monitor delta in evals, ability to rollback automatically if errors increase. also add telemetry sampling markers so eval dashboards can exclude rollout-influenced traffic.
Ryan: migration plan: introduce saved_views_v2 with new columns and feature flag savedviews_v2. reads fallback to v1 unless flag enabled. write-through on create. background migration job to backfill hints as null. ensure API returns stable shape for old clients.
deploy-bot: feature-flag savedviews_v2 toggled to staging at 14:12 UTC :rocket:
Alex: next steps: i'll draft a short PRD with the UX mock and the default 'preview-only' behavior. @Ryan to draft API + migration proposal. @Sam to add rollout + telemetry gating to ops runbook. sync tomorrow 10am PT to review.
